findings.title: Generated serialization hooks permit unchecked mutation and construction
violated_requirements: one immutable Evaluation with no mutable caller alias
every public constructor/factory/object-mutation route must preserve validation
at most one primary and at most two immutable contributors
strict bool abstain and LOW requires abstention without errors
findings.impact: A caller holding an ordinary factory-created Evaluation can call its generated instance __setstate__ method to replace any field, inject future-stage/unlearned/unknown formal errors, arbitrary Skill and invalid abstention/confidence, and retain mutable lists. Subsequent list changes alter the supposedly frozen Evaluation. Standard pickle.loads for protocols 0 and 1 also constructs a distinct exact Evaluation from edited in-memory state without factory/Training validation, bypassing blocked __new__. No caller low-level allocation/reflection is needed.

related_test_location.blind_spot: Constructor/replace/setattr/delattr tests omit generated serialization state restoration hook.

findings.reproduction: Create a valid S1 attempt (learned CON-S1-HIGH) and factory Evaluation; call e.__setstate__([e.attempt_id, mutable_positive_list, "LOC-006; OBS-002", "LOC-001", mutable_contributor_list, "LOC-002", "SKL-S8-CALLER-OVERRIDE", "LOW", 1]). The method returns normally. Injected future-stage/unknown/over-cardinality errors, Error-ID prose, caller Skill, LOW/non-bool abstain persist; later list append changes the record. No caller low-level allocation/setattr is used.
